data.name: Jagveer
data.gender_notes: Jagveer is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jagveer is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jagat' meaning 'world' and 'veer' meaning 'hero' or 'victorious'. This name signifies a brave and invincible individual, who is victorious over the world. The name Jagveer carries the meaning “Victorious, Invincible” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jagveer usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, invincible and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jagveer belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Invincible.”

data.cultural_impact: The name Jagveer is deeply rooted in the rich cultural heritage of Hinduism. In Hindu mythology, the deity Shiva is known as Jagatpate, the ruler of the universe. Bhagwan Jagannath, one of the major deities of the Hindu faith, is also believed to have the power to protect and govern the cosmos. The name Jagveer carries this divine sense of protection, invincibility, and rulership, which is highly revered in Indian culture and history. Additionally, the name has been borne by various legendary warriors, kings, and revolutionaries in India, inspiring generations with their courage, bravery, and unwavering spirit.
data.spiritual_significance: The divine meaning and origin of the name Jagveer hold significant spiritual significance for Hindus. The name Varaha Avatar of Lord Vishnu, who is known for restoring cosmic peace, carries the same meaning – 'jagat' meaning 'world' and 'veer' meaning 'hero'. As the hero of the world, he engages in the eternal struggle between good and evil, representing the spirit of victory and preservation. Jagveer symbolizes the idea that each individual has the potential to embody this heroic spirit, drawing strength from the divine and applying it in everyday life to overcome challenges and bring balance to the world. This name is a reminder of the spiritual power and inner strength that resides in every Hindu, instilling a sense of hope and determination.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Jagveer symbolizes the indomitable spirit of an individual, unyielding and fearless, constantly battling against the darkness within and without, driven by their inner light and truth. The name Jagveer, meaning 'unconquerable', conveys the strength and resilience of the individual, who is unwavering in their convictions and unwavering in their pursuit of truth and righteousness.

historical_references.reference: Jagveer Singh, a prominent Sikh military leader who served under Maharaja Ranjit Singh in the late 18th and early 19th centuries. He is known for his victory over the Afghan invasion in 1809.
